title.original: AgentWebBench: Benchmarking Multi-Agent Coordination in Agentic Web
title.zh: AgentWebBench：在智能体 Web中对多智能体协调进行基准测试
title.en: AgentWebBench: Benchmarking Multi-Agent Coordination in Agentic Web

inclusion_reason.zh: AgentWebBench 的内容 Agent API、用户编排器和多任务评测器共同构成去中心化 Agentic Web 实验基础设施。
inclusion_reason.en: AgentWebBench combines content-agent APIs, user orchestration, and multi-task evaluators into experimental infrastructure for a decentralized Agentic Web.

abstract.zh: AgentWebBench 构造由用户 Agent 向网站内容 Agent 分散取证的 Agentic Web，覆盖检索、推荐、问答和深度研究四类任务。
abstract.en: AgentWebBench models an Agentic Web where a user agent gathers evidence from site-specific content agents across retrieval, recommendation, QA, and deep-research tasks.

problem.zh: 当网站以 Agent 控制数据接口后，信息访问从中心检索转为去中心协商，传统搜索基准无法衡量规划、交互和证据合成。
problem.en: When websites expose controlled agent interfaces, access shifts from centralized retrieval to decentralized negotiation, which search benchmarks cannot measure for planning, interaction, and synthesis.

approach.zh: 基准让用户 Agent 在不可直接读取语料的约束下调用多个内容 Agent，并比较不同模型、协调策略与测试时扩展。
approach.en: The benchmark prevents direct corpus access, requiring a user agent to interact with multiple content agents while varying models, coordination strategies, and test-time scaling.

system_design.zh: 系统包含网站隔离语料、内容 Agent API、用户 Agent 编排器、交互预算和针对排序或开放回答的任务评测器。
system_design.en: The system contains site-isolated corpora, content-agent APIs, a user-agent orchestrator, interaction budgets, and evaluators for ranked or open-ended outputs.

key_results.zh: 去中心访问总体落后中心检索，但差距随模型规模缩小；充分且有规划的交互可改善可靠性，部分问答甚至反超。
key_results.en: Decentralized access generally trails centralized retrieval, but the gap narrows with model scale; sufficient planned interaction improves reliability and can surpass centralized QA.

limitations.zh: 内容 Agent 的合作策略和语料分区由基准设定，尚未覆盖收费、对抗排序、隐私政策或真实网站之间的经济博弈。
limitations.en: Content-agent behavior and corpus partitioning are benchmark-controlled, omitting pricing, adversarial ranking, privacy policy, and economic incentives among real sites.

notes.zh: 上述非空 evaluation 标签仅来自官方 arXiv 摘要；摘要未给出可安全转录的表格级数值、硬件与集群配置，相关细节仍待全文审计。
notes.en: The non-empty evaluation labels above come only from the official arXiv abstract; it provides no table-level numbers, hardware, or cluster configuration safe to transcribe, so those details await full-text audit.
